common_state.clock: accepted interval[t,t+dt], mechanics may subcycle; end T produces trial geometry at t+dt; emission uses accepted start state
identities: mechanics material provenance and stress-free T
common_state.species: empty event/parent lists; no electron/heavy inventory mutation
common_state.reference_measure: each cell value is full3D joules over fixed reference material volume
common_state.density: same rho_ref as mechanics; current density is rho_ref*Vref/Vcurrent

thermodynamic_model.base: separate owner's stress-free reference caloric U0(T); explicit nominal Cp-as-Cv proxy retained
thermodynamic_model.elastic_internal_density: Uel=Phi-T*dPhi/dT; signed excess, not constrained nonnegative
thermodynamic_model.thermal_base_debit_J: DeltaUel-Wstress; positive means remove base thermal energy
thermodynamic_model.closure: DeltaK+DeltaUel+DeltaU0 = supplied_external_heat + support_work; homogeneous immobile supports have zero support work
thermodynamic_model.separate_algorithmic_quantity: DeltaPhi-Wstress is a strain-energy reservoir debit and must NOT replace thermodynamic debit
thermodynamic_model.range: retain293.15..773.15K mechanics support and caloric lower300K; thermodynamic transactions additionally remain inside one open smooth coefficient segment
thermodynamic_model.knots: reject crossing/landing at derivative discontinuities rather than invent latent heat
thermodynamic_model.plasticity: nominal vonMises/proof-stress screen rejects unsupported elastic trials

consumer_sequence: Freeze accepted thermal/geometry/material/source revisions and reference masses.
Prepare trial endT and mechanical subcycles against the same accepted state; reject temperature, derivative-segment, stress or geometry failures.
Build signed cellJ exchange with the full subcycle stress-work path and verify its mesh/material/payload bindings.
Collapse axial cellJ once and conservatively remap onto the thermal XY reference cells with project_exchange_to_thermal_xy.
Native2D FE assembly divides full3D cellJ by the reference axial extent exactly once and records the dedicated internal thermoelastic exchange ledger.
Recompute thermal endT and mechanics until local/global energy residuals and interface stages converge; the local-cell prototype demonstrates this corrector but omits native conduction.
Parent preflights and commits all thermal/geometry/field/source ports together, retaining replay/restart identities. No component independently commits a partial trial.

concrete_native_api_gap.current_heat_Transfer: does not expose a dedicated reversible mechanical internal-exchange entry
concrete_native_api_gap.required_addition: signed reference cellJ mechanical exchange plus transaction/mesh/material/stage identity and a separate internal ledger category
concrete_native_api_gap.forbidden_substitution: do not encode this debit as authored_heat_J, solid Joule heat, PIC electric work, or a duplicated wall collection term
concrete_native_api_gap.mesh: reference energy remap and deformed surfaces exist; native moving-domain conductivity/EM operators and boundary/circuit work remain unqualified

supports.meaning: explicit sensitivity scenarios, not measured constraints or rigorous response bounds
supports.missing: short structural thickness, bridge/joint stiffness and mechanical anchoring; none inferred from electrical BCs
